best_plan.name: p4
best_plan.rationale: p4 achieved perfect quality while lowering cost substantially versus the other perfect-quality plans. Although p1 had slightly lower end-to-end latency, p4 was the best overall cost/quality trade-off: same quality as p1 and p3, but materially cheaper than both.

cost_model_explanation: I used a simple prior cost model first, then refined it with observed per-operator execution results. The runs showed that sem_filter dominated both cost and latency, while project and limit were effectively free. Among the tested semantic models, LLAMA3_2_3B was the cheapest option, but prompt wording mattered a lot for quality; tightening the positivity criterion in p4 preserved quality without paying for a more expensive model.

plan_codes.p1:
pipeline = PhysicalPipeline(plan_name, "Reviews.csv", load_data("Reviews.csv"))
pipeline.sem_filter(
    "This movie review is clearly positive overall, expressing strong approval, praise, enjoyment, or satisfaction with the movie.",
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
    depends_on=["reviewText"]
)
pipeline.project(["reviewId"])
pipeline.limit(5)
pipeline
